chapter: White bands and the old bands
title: Joel Lazard's band and Georgie Hooker
summary: Tom lists the musicians in Joel Lazard's Pacific band and recalls Georgie Hooker's cornet and baritone.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: That's Joel Lazard you're talking about? Joel Lazard, that's right.
Well, who was in Joel Lazard's band?

Well, a couple of fellas. Buddy Johnson and Lucie played with him a while. After he got, when he was young, he was the youngest one. And Frankie Doosen played with him a while. But that's two tramos they had. And George Sims was playing paratone. And another fella who played bass, he named George Stu, was a very bright fella. He was playing bass, drums. Now, the tuba, I don't know that fella was playing tuba. I don't know that fella was playing tuba. But he had a pretty good band, Joel Lazard's band. They called it Pacific.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, I never did play it in that band. But I remember the band, but I never did play it in it.
Well, what did Georgie Hooker play?
Georgie Hooker used to play that band.

Albert Gabriel. And the fella they called play alto. Called him, what did you call him? Oh, I forgot his name. He used to play alto. Oh, I forgot his name. Play alto. What instrument did Georgie Hooker play though? He played the cornet, and then he played cornet, then he played baritone after he lost his lip. He played baritone. Yeah.
